Your holdings: SMH is right at its stop at 540, needing immediate attention. Your leveraged ETFs, SOXL and SPAL, are down significantly (-56.31% and -59.17% respectively) and decay over time, amplifying losses on margin. QQQ and QQQI are also flagged for trimming.

Watch: Keep a close eye on SMH at its stop. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs for further decay and consider their risk given your margin use.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk, especially with stops and leveraged positions, as market leadership might be shifting.
plays: Respect the SMH stop at 540; it's right there and needs to be honored to prevent further losses.
Review SOXL and SPAL given their deep losses and leveraged decay; consider if these positions still fit your risk tolerance on margin.
Consider trimming QQQ and QQQI as your scanner suggests, especially with the headline about big tech's gap vanishing.
